data.title: GET Query Builder
data.statement:
Your task is to build the complete URL for an HTTP GET request from a base URL and a list of parameters.

Formatting rules:

If there are parameters, the first one must be separated from the base URL by a question mark ?.

The following parameters must be separated from each other by an ampersand &.

Each parameter is formatted as key=value.

If there are no parameters, you must simply return the base URL as is.

testCases.title: Test 4
testCases.testIn:
api.weather.com/v1/forecast
10
lat 48.85
lon 2.35
units metric
lang en
exclude alerts
key abc123
format json
limit 5
offset 0
cors true

testCases.title: Validator 4
testCases.testIn:
analytics.cloud.net
10
user 9982
type event
source web
session abcd123
theme dark
lang en
region us
tracking true
version 2.5
device mobile

data.constraints:
0 ≤ N ≤ 10
baseUrl, key, and value contain only alphanumeric characters and dots (no spaces or special characters requiring encoding).
data.stubGenerator:
read baseUrl:word(256)
read N:int
loop N read key:word(100) value:word(256)
write answer
data.inputDescription:
Line 1: A string baseUrl.
Line 2: An integer N representing the number of parameters.
Next N lines: Two space-separated strings key and value, representing the key and the value of the parameter.
data.outputDescription: A single line containing the correctly formatted complete URL.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Your task is to build the complete URL for an HTTP GET request from a base URL and a list of parameters.

Formatting rules:

If there are parameters, the first one must be separated from the base URL by a question mark ?.

The following parameters must be separated from each other by an ampersand &.

Each parameter is formatted as key=value.

If there are no parameters, you must simply return the base URL as is.
Input
Line 1: A string baseUrl.
Line 2: An integer N representing the number of parameters.
Next N lines: Two space-separated strings key and value, representing the key and the value of the parameter.
Output
A single line containing the correctly formatted complete URL.
Constraints
0 ≤ N ≤ 10
baseUrl, key, and value contain only alphanumeric characters and dots (no spaces or special characters requiring encoding).
Example
Input
api.mysite.com/data
0
Output
api.mysite.com/data
